Community of Madrid (Comunidad de Madrid) — Spanje Reisgids: Bezienswaardigheden, Bereikbaarheid & Eten

Prado, Reina Sofía & Thyssen-Bornemisza Museums, Royal Palace & Retiro Park, San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Aranjuez & Alcalá de Henares. Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD); Puerta de Atocha and Chamartín stations are the center of Spain's radial AVE rail network.
